summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on its ongoing share buyback program. The company reported purchases under the second tranche of a multi-year €3.5 billion program expected to run through 2030, with daily transactions on Euronext Milan and NYSE from May 26-28, 2026, totaling 90,239 shares at an average price of €285.42 per share, for €25.8 million consideration. As of June 2, it held 17.8 million treasury shares (9.20% of issued common shares). No board recommendation or advisor was named; the cancellation of treasury shares was approved but not yet effectuated. Watch for continued execution pace and potential cancellation updates.
